blockers.finding: The source is a ten-period nested budget with personnel, equipment, travel, participant support, other direct costs, indirect costs, attachments, and period/cumulative calculations.
Project/subaward type, the $5,000 equipment threshold, attachment overflow, and a single budget-justification attachment are material static and behavioral constraints.
Official metadata declares no separate instruction PDF, so calculation and policy meaning beyond the pinned XSD, DAT, and visible pages remains unaccepted.

claims_boundary: XSD and DAT extraction is deterministic. Component, role, question, and behavior bindings emitted by this family are agent-proposed and do not contribute to published coverage metrics until reviewed.
